milestones.outcome: A stable recorded CLI/GHES pull request loads its real update history and exact selected-file comparisons, and Overview Start review enters Review with an honest usable selection or explicit unavailable state without publishing anything.
exit_criteria: A composed recorded CLI/GHES fixture proves the first missing or refused history/comparison boundary and records whether the two reported symptoms share a cause.
Supported stable base/head comparisons open intended content for multiple files while real authority, head, selection and stale-completion replacements still reject stale content.
Available update history is projected after PR load and loading, genuine empty, unavailable and failed states are distinct without inventing epochs or retaining another PR's history.

The composed Overview Start review gesture enters Review with an appropriate selected file or an honest empty/error state; Continue review retains its intended place and neither navigation path publishes remotely.

Focused positive and negative checks, the direct composed public path, the documentation gate and one integration-focused selector pass, with no live GitHub/GHES mutation or credential/private-content capture.
milestones.boundary: One functional first-review entry boundary spanning BPR-0922, BPR-0921 and BPR-0919; layout redesign and Markdown rendering remain outside this milestone.

milestones.outcome: The Overview description and conversation/review surfaces have concrete evidence-backed layout decisions, clear loading/filtering states and bounded implementation follow-ups where investigation cards do not themselves deliver runtime behavior.
exit_criteria: Synthetic short, long and very long bodies distinguish provider admission from viewport limits and demonstrate the selected full-body reading interaction across representative widths, fonts and input methods.

The reported drawer gap and clipped controls are identified, and the selected placement preserves drafts, explicit publication semantics and useful input space without changing authentication or publication authority.
Thread loading, revealing, filtering, empty and failure states have a clear reachable interaction, and Discuss can present known PR-wide conversations without requiring a source comparison.
Every design-only card records the selected design and an allocated linked implementation follow-up with runtime acceptance; investigation alone is not accepted as the RFC behavior.
milestones.boundary: One evidence-backed layout/design boundary; source correctness is consumed, Markdown stays under RFC-BPR-0036 and all runtime follow-ups remain linked to RFC-BPR-0037.

milestones.outcome: The selected conversation layouts, thread sizing and graph/detail behavior form one coherent responsive reading path with complete admitted bodies and no unexplained duplicate full thread.
exit_criteria: Synthetic long threads identify the clipping and scroll owners, and complete admitted bodies are reachable without accidental nested scroll traps at representative widths, fonts and display scales.
Wheel, trackpad and keyboard behavior has observed or measured responsive evidence, with sensible focus and reading-position behavior across selection, expansion and refresh.

The graph and selected-thread detail preserve comment/thread identity and navigation while exposing one understandable body-reading path with consistent presentation and no unexplained duplicate full content.
All implementation follow-ups allocated by the preceding design milestone are completed or remain explicitly bound as unsatisfied obligations before this milestone can be accepted.
milestones.boundary: One integrated conversation-reading boundary; no broad publication, provider or Markdown authority change.

milestones.outcome: The combined Overview to Review and Overview to Discuss courses are verified against all RFC-BPR-0037 criteria and the RFC records truthful dependency-ordered closeout state.
exit_criteria: Every RFC-BPR-0037 criterion and linked implementation follow-up has direct revision-bound evidence, including initial load, failures, empty content, refresh, authority replacement, head changes and retained selection/drafts.

The combined recorded-fixture course loads a PR, reaches update history and multiple exact source files, enters Review correctly and reads conversations without an accidental file-selection prerequisite.

Applicable target-native accessibility, responsive-layout and scrolling observations are recorded separately from deterministic tests, and unavailable platform or live-service evidence remains explicit.
Documentation and board validation pass; RFC/index status changes only when canonical dependencies and every closeout obligation permit it.
milestones.boundary: One RFC closeout boundary against registration baseline 9bd2002b859ce4c5599d86dcc51771aa365fa90b; no claim for RFC-BPR-0036 Markdown work or unobserved platforms.
